nodes.label: Volunteer Profile Screen
nodes.description: Dashboard screen showing a volunteer's profile (Miha Lufler). Contains personal info (EMSO masked as ***(3)), address (Obokova 6, 3270 Lasko), monthly hours (4.0), registration date (2026-05-02), monthly report preferences (e-mail checked, WhatsApp unchecked), and a work diary table with entries showing DATUM DELA, OPIS DELA, URE, LOKACIJA, DAN VNOSA, STATUS columns. Entries show statuses like 'Odobreno'. Navigation sidebar includes Prostovoljci, Dnevniki, Analitika, Porocila, Nastavitve, Dokumenti, Administracija, Dnevnik napak, Odjava.

nodes.label: Manager Dashboard Sidebar Navigation
nodes.description: Left sidebar navigation with BelPro logo and menu items: Prostovoljci, Dnevniki, Analitika, Porocila, Nastavitve, Dokumenti, Administracija, Dnevnik napak, Odjava. 'Prostovoljci' is currently active/selected.

nodes.label: Volunteer Work Diary Table
nodes.description: Paginated table listing volunteer work diary entries. Columns: DATUM DELA, OPIS DELA, URE, LOKACIJA, DAN VNOSA, STATUS. Includes date range filters, search by description, and a 'Ponastavit' (reset) button. Entries include tasks like 'Zracenje spodnjih blac', 'Pulenje dlje iz mosa', 'Pitve piva in zapiranje kolenec'. Status shows 'Odobreno' (Approved). Pagination shown at bottom.

nodes.label: Monthly Report Notification Preferences
nodes.description: Section titled 'Mesecna porocila' with checkbox options for report delivery: 'Posljanje mesecnih porocil' (master toggle, checked), 'E-posta' (checked), 'WhatsApp' (unchecked). Includes a 'Shrani' (Save) button.
